Row.Text: Worked, unpillaged improvements adjacent to their city provide +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold to that city. Eligible buildings completed with [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production earn 20% of their full Production cost as Gold once per building class per city. Each new [ICON_CITIZEN] Population milestone has a 25% chance to trigger a Property Sale. A sale earns 10 Gold per new Population, scaled by era and game speed, and provides +10% city Production for 5 turns on Standard speed. Non-capital cities connected to the capital gain +5% Gold and Production, rising to +10% at 10 Population.
Develop and work the tiles around your cities, invest in infrastructure, and connect your growing suburbs. Cultivate City-State alliances with the proceeds of your Trade Missions.
A fictional commercial civilization inspired by real-estate work in Werribee, Victoria, Australia.

In this fictional setting, a network of bustling suburbs grows along the western edge of Melbourne. Real Estate Offices coordinate development and dispatch Senior Sales Consultants across the world. Their success depends on productive land, well-connected neighbourhoods and durable partnerships with City-States.
Senior Sales Consultant Lynne Steinhauer leads the Werribee Property Network.
Lynne's role as a Senior Sales Consultant in Werribee inspired this fictional strategy-game leader. Her in-game dialogue, political career and accomplishments are creative game content.

Replaces the Great Merchant. Can build a Customs House or conduct a City-State Trade Mission. While stationed in the centre of an owned city, adds +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold for each improved, unpillaged adjacent tile worked by that city and +10% city Gold. Only one appraisal applies per city. A successful Trade Mission earns 25 extra Gold per current [ICON_CITIZEN] Population in the origin city, with the capital as fallback. It also gives that city +15% Gold and Great Person generation for 10 turns on Standard speed.

Station a Consultant in a developed city for Local Market Appraisal. Send one from a populous city on a Trade Mission for extra Gold and a temporary Vendor Network. A new mission refreshes the duration.

The Senior Sales Consultant brings local knowledge to Werribee's busiest neighbourhoods and builds commercial partnerships with City-States. Like other Great Merchants, a Consultant may establish a Customs House.

Replaces the Market and keeps its benefits. Worked, unpillaged Farms, Pastures and Trading Posts throughout the city's workable radius yield +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold. Adds 1 flat Gold per 3 current [ICON_CITIZEN] Population. Each new Population milestone earns 5 Gold per new Population, scaled by game speed. While accumulating surplus [ICON_FOOD] Food toward growth, the city gains +10% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production toward buildings.

Build a Real Estate Office in a growing city with Farms, Pastures or Trading Posts. Property Boom requires positive net Food and growth enabled. It stops during resistance or when Food is diverted to Production.
Werribee's Real Estate Offices connect buyers, builders and growing neighbourhoods. Their local knowledge turns development and new residents into revenue.

Welcome, Lynne Steinhauer, trusted negotiator and architect of prosperity. From the growing streets of Werribee, families seek homes, merchants seek opportunity, and new communities rise where once there was open land. Through keen appraisal and careful negotiation, every plot may become an opportunity and every growing suburb a source of prosperity.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Build thriving communities, connect your cities, and allow commerce to follow population wherever it grows. Let your agents travel abroad and return with fortunes while your citizens transform humble settlements into prosperous centres.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Will you build a market whose influence stretches beyond Werribee? Will the world one day declare that everything has its price? Can you build a civilization that will stand the test of time?
